fusions.name: Herd Surge
fusions.desc: Stampedes through a wide cone 6 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage. If it hits anything, your party deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Close Ranks
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 7 damage, rising by 8% for each ally near you (up to 32%), and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cast the Hobbles
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you and from each member of your party.

fusions.name: Last Furlong
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
